question: According to the Constitution of India, there shall be a Comptroller and Auditor General of India who shall be appointed by the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is the __**President of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Comptroller and Auditor General** are one of the few offices directly appointed by the President of India.
 
• The second timetable of the Indian charter offers provisions for the **Comptroller and Auditor standard of India.**
